title: Curator follow-up: 7 microbedecoder residual labels are synonyms of existing MIM records (incl. RNA split)
body:
From PR #202 (microbedecoder residual deep-research). While applying the single-term groundings, 7 labels researched as "net-new" turned out to already be mapped in MIM under a canonical label. These were **not** force-promoted (doing so left dangling unmapped duplicates and, for RNA, a bad merge). They need a curator **synonym pass**:

| residual label | CHEBI | existing MIM record | action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Alpha-hydroxybutyrate | CHEBI:64552 | `2-hydroxybutyrate` | add synonym |
| Beta-hydroxybutyrate | CHEBI:37054 | `3-hydroxybutyrate` | add synonym |
| Achromycin | CHEBI:27902 | `Tetracycline` | add trade-name synonym |
| Neomycin E | CHEBI:7934 | `Paromomycin` | add synonym |
| (+)-D-glycogen | CHEBI:28087 | `Glycogen` | add synonym (parse artifact) |
| (+)-L-lyxitol | CHEBI:18403 | `Arabitol` | confirm enantiomer (L-arabinitol), add synonym |
| RNA | CHEBI:33697 | `Ribonucleic acid from torula yeast type VI` | **split** — generic RNA must not merge onto the specific Torula-yeast product record |

The residual UNMAPPED_* records for these remain in `data/ingredients/unmapped/`; the synonym pass should attach the label to the existing mapped record and retire the duplicate.

Also parked in the same PR's ledger (`microbedecoder_residual_research_proposed.sssom.tsv`): 3 non-CHEBI parse/variant merges (Peptones, Peptone/Yeast-Extract `(0.01 %` → `MIM:Peptone` / `MIM:Yeast_Extract`), 6 antibiotics blocked on #200, and filipin (broadMatch, needs a registry sibling).
